notes.title: New SK Minimaps and USL Season 25 update.
notes.notes:
Military Police has added two new maps to the SK Minimaps zone, come and check them out.

FireIce and HeatFrost are now playable, players may vote to use these maps between games.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/37c484dcbb7d1bc32b3e636c755ccf7a9bdce458.png

Unified Skirmish League Season 25!

Season 25 of USL continues with only two weeks left before playoffs.

Current standings as of this post:

Jersey Boys 5-1
Birds 4-1
Sparta 2-3
Darkslayers 2-3
Talking Smack Sunday 0-5

Week 4 results:

Jersey Boys over Sparta 65-47 (MVP: THE MOUNTAIN)
Darkslayers over Talking Smack Sunday 76-39 (MVP: Chuck)
Birds over Jersey Boys 43-25 (MVP: Sabotage)

Playoff map voting!

Voting has concluded for the map choice for the semifinals game with Elsdragon Compound winning the vote.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/f9f683676b750211515e6379d7a0cfc31cfc1f60.png

Voting is still ongoing for the championship map with Kaiser Pass currently leading by a large margin.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921492/fbacde18aa8d091303778d6d1298844c4112fbb8.png

If you're interested in participating in the Unified Skirmish League or want to learn more information you can join the official USL Discord or visit the Uslzone website.
